description:
Initialization only: Beam Search.
- Beam Construction: Expand task prefixes with beam width 3.
- Completion & Scoring: Complete each prefix with remaining tasks in ascending ID order; evaluate full sequence via C.
- Selection: Retain up to three prefixes by descending score; break ties by the lexicographic string form of the prefix.
- Termination: Stop when all task depths are processed, the beam is empty, or the evaluation limit is reached; return best issued trial.
